name: Numakers PETG-HS Clear @Solder
filament_notes: Numakers PETG-HS Transparent. Clarity variant of Numakers PETG-HS @Solder - use only with the process preset 0.12mm Clear @Solder. Two values differ from the opaque preset and both are the point of this file. FAN IS 0% AT EVERY LAYER: fast cooling freezes the interface between extrusions before it fuses, and an unfused interface refracts. Overhangs and bridges will be poor as a direct consequence; that is the trade. Layer time is held by slow_down_layer_time 12 instead, so thin layers are stretched rather than cooled. FLOW 1.00 vs 0.95 on the opaque preset is a real +5% - it pushes material into the remaining voids and is the largest single lever on clarity. Push toward 1.05 if the part is still milky, but calibrate the extruder first: rotation_distance 34.406 is nominal, so run E_CAL_START / E_CAL_RESULT before reading a flow number as meaningful. Temperature is pinned at 250 both layers - the hotend is all-metal with PTFE cold-side only, and PETG below about 245 skips in it. Higher than 250 makes microbubbles, which is its own kind of milky. Filament must be dry; a damp spool cannot print clear at any setting.
filament_start_gcode: SET_PRESSURE_ADVANCE ADVANCE=0.04 ; starting point for direct drive PETG, NOT measured - run a PA tower, see calibration.md
